prompt: A team wants to encrypt client connections to a database that runs on a Free Redis Cloud Essentials plan. What should they do?
explanation: TLS is available on Paid Redis Cloud Essentials plans and on Redis Cloud Pro, but it is not available for Free Redis Cloud Essentials — so upgrading is the only way to add it. Toggling TLS, adding certificates, and rotating the Default user password are paid-plan actions or unrelated to TLS entirely.

options.text: Upgrade to a paid Essentials plan or Redis Cloud Pro, because TLS is not available on the Free plan
Enable the TLS toggle in the database's Security section, which is free on every plan
Add the Redis Cloud certificate authority bundle to the subscription to unlock TLS
Rotate the Default user password, which automatically turns on TLS
